provenance.retrieval_method: overlay file words at the link address

functions.name: title_menu_00a87880
functions.interpretation: hg_title_menu: title presentation and menu by minor (mode +9); returns 1 on a confirmed choice (mode +11), 3 on the attract timeout. Without a save the cursor skips the Continue row.

functions.name: title_card_poll_00a87de0
